Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in statistics rows caused test failures in the weighted cloud reliability workbook.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed because cells H46:L47 returned #NAME? instead of expected numeric values. This error typically indicates a typo in a formula name, a missing named range, or an unsupported function in the generated openpyxl workbook. While basic structure and lookup blocks passed, the statistical summary calculations (EXPECTED_STATS) are currently broken.
